opencode: profile field "permissions.disableBypass" is not supported and was not rendered
opencode: profile field "permissions.sandbox" is not supported and was not rendered
opencode: profile field "egress.default" is not supported and was not rendered
opencode: profile field "egress.deniedDomains" is not supported and was not rendered
opencode: profile field "egress.presets" is not supported and was not rendered
opencode: profile field "sandbox.writableRoots" is not supported and was not rendered
opencode: sandbox.protectedPaths are rendered as read/edit deny rules for the file tools; bash can still read them (no sandbox)
opencode: egress is rendered as the webfetch permission (one action for every URL: deny when nothing is allowed, else ask), so fetches cannot be limited to the allowlist [gw.example.com registry.npmjs.org pypi.org files.pythonhosted.org proxy.golang.org sum.golang.org index.crates.io static.crates.io repo.maven.apache.org rubygems.org]; bash network access is not restricted (no sandbox)
opencode: cannot self-enforce version; halod enforces
opencode: no gateway configured; traffic is not routed through Halos
opencode: ring/release request headers need a gateway provider; not rendered
opencode: permissions.disableBypass cannot be enforced: `--auto` approves every ask (explicit deny rules still hold) and the OPENCODE_PERMISSION environment variable overrides the managed permission block; render deny rules for what must never run
